description: This file defines the Store2 class, which implements gRPC-based storage and configuration interfaces for a plugin in the WPEFramework. It includes methods for setting, getting, and deleting key-value pairs, managing notifications, and handling gRPC communication with a remote secure storage service.

classes.name: Store2
classes.description: A class implementing gRPC-based storage and configuration interfaces, managing secure storage operations, notifications, and gRPC communication.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A nested class within Store2 that dispatches value change notifications asynchronously.

methods.name: Store2
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the Store2 object with environment variables.

methods.name: Store2
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Store2 object with specified URI and token, and opens the gRPC channel.

methods.name: ~Store2
methods.description: Destructor that releases the service reference.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Initializes the gRPC stub with the specified URI and credentials.

methods.name: IsTimeSynced
methods.description: Checks if the system time is synchronized, optionally using system manager calls.

methods.name: GetToken
methods.description: Retrieves the current authentication token from the auth service.

methods.name: GetPartnerId
methods.description: Reads the partner ID from a file.

methods.name: GetAccountId
methods.description: Reads the account ID from a file.

methods.name: GetDeviceId
methods.description: Reads the device ID from a file.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for value changes.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the remote storage with optional TTL.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value and TTL for a given key.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the Store2 instance with a service shell.

methods.name: OnValueChanged
methods.description: Notifies registered callbacks of a value change.
